description: Implementation of InterfaceFactoryImpl class for creating media-related Mojo interfaces, including decoders, renderers, and CDM services, with conditional compilation based on build flags.

classes.name: InterfaceFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implements creation of media interfaces such as decoders, renderers, and CDM services, managing their lifecycle and disconnections.

methods.name: CreateAudioDecoder
methods.description: Creates and adds an AudioDecoder service if enabled.

methods.name: CreateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates and adds a VideoDecoder service, with support for out-of-process decoding if enabled.

methods.name: CreateAudioEncoder
methods.description: Creates and adds an AudioEncoder service if enabled.

methods.name: CreateDefaultRenderer
methods.description: Creates and adds a default Renderer if enabled.

methods.name: CreateCastRenderer
methods.description: Creates and adds a Cast Renderer if enabled.

methods.name: CreateMediaPlayerRenderer
methods.description: Stub for creating MediaPlayerRenderer, not implemented.

methods.name: CreateFlingingRenderer
methods.description: Stub for creating FlingingRenderer, not implemented.

methods.name: CreateMediaFoundationRenderer
methods.description: Creates and adds a MediaFoundationRenderer if on Windows.

methods.name: CreateCdm
methods.description: Creates a Content Decryption Module (CDM) service if supported.

methods.name: OnDestroyPending
methods.description: Sets a callback to destroy the object when all references are gone.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all service receivers are empty.

methods.name: SetReceiverDisconnectHandler
methods.description: Sets disconnect handlers for all service receivers.

methods.name: OnReceiverDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection of any receiver, triggers destruction if all are disconnected.

methods.name: AddRenderer
methods.description: Adds a Renderer service to the receiver list.

methods.name: GetCdmFactory
methods.description: Lazily creates and returns the CdmFactory.

methods.name: OnCdmServiceInitialized
methods.description: Handles initialization completion of a CDM service, passing the remote interface.

methods.name: FinishCreatingVideoDecoder
methods.description: Completes creation of a video decoder when out-of-process decoding is enabled.
